stem:
Point Y is labeled on the number line.

[Number line from 0 to 1 with point Y marked exactly halfway between 0 and 1]

Which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: Point Y represents \( \frac{3}{6} \) and \( \frac{3}{4} \), because both fractions represent 3 equal parts of a whole.

options.label: B
options.text: Point Y represents \( \frac{3}{6} \) and \( \frac{1}{2} \), because both fractions are exactly halfway between 0 and 1 on the number line.

options.label: C
options.text: Point Y represents \( \frac{4}{6} \) and \( \frac{3}{6} \), because both fractions represent 6 equal parts of a whole.

options.label: D
options.text: Point Y represents \( \frac{4}{6} \) and \( \frac{1}{2} \), because both fractions are exactly halfway between 0 and 1 on the number line.

visual_elements: Number line from 0 to 1 with point Y marked exactly halfway between 0 and 1
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding of fractions as points on a number line, equivalence of fractions, and interpreting which fractions correctly represent the marked point.
